dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can't you get anyone to help you?

dialogues.speaker: Zybina
dialogues.text: We did have this "technical expert" with us before... And troubleshooting and problem-fixing was a lot smoother and quicker when he was around.

dialogues.speaker: Zybina
dialogues.text: But that gentleman must've been sent somewhere else, since we don't see him much around here anymore. I'm the only one left around here to handle these technical issues now.
